justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/MethodGraph.java` (lines 1911-1955) and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/MethodGraphNodeListTest.java` (lines 19-56). `NodeList` is a small nested wrapper with one field and only five simple members (`get`, `size`, `wrap`, `asMethodList`, constructor), and its behavior is limited to list delegation plus a single conversion to `MethodList`; the test class also exercises only generic list behavior and that conversion. There is no evidence of excessive size, many public methods, or multiple distinct responsibilities, so insufficient modularization is not present.
